name: fwrd-sms-mcp
description: An MCP server that hands your AI agent the SMS verification codes the Fwrd iPhone app forwards. Runs on your own Cloudflare account.

FWRD_TOKEN.description: The secret at the end of the URL you paste into Fwrd's Webhook destination. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

MCP_TOKEN.description: The secret your AI client sends to `/mcp`. Use a different value from FWRD_TOKEN: `openssl rand -hex 32`.
